what: Four cards stacked at a slant (−3°, 5°, −3°, −3°). When the top of the group reaches screen center, they fly in from 100vw to the right, tilted 40° and pivoting on the bottom-right corner, and settle (1s back.out, staggered over .4s). Hovering one card straightens it to 1.1x and 0°, and the neighbors step aside by a preset share of screen width (.8s outBack). When the pointer leaves they return in .6s

options.rest: Resting tilt per card (degrees, comma-separated), default -3,5,-3,-3
options.push: Push of other cards per raised card (vw) — split rows with / and cards with commas, default 0,7,5,5 / -10,0,8,8 / -15,-8,0,10 / -10,-8,-10,0 (brand review)
options.enter: If none, turns off the fly-in entrance
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Stacked cards (siblings, 2–4 — from the fifth on, use the last line of push)

from.where: shared.js PUSH.tst · .sx-tst__cards .sx-card (four testimonial cards — original Webflow IX2 Testimonial card 1~4 hover · IX3 [data-slide-cards] top center)
shared.js PUSH.life · studio.html .s-life__imgs .s-life__item (four life photos — push: 0,7,5,5 / 2,0,2,2 / -15,-8,0,10 / -10,-8,-10,0)

note: At 991 and below, the original unfolds the cards into a grid and turns motion off. The part turns off both hand response and entrance on touch devices (hover false). The overlapping card layout (negative margins, z-index) is the host css’s job.
